original_en: First Contact
translation_zh: 第一次接觸

original_en: Glistening like a washroom\rfloor, the walls of the\rstation are blindingly clean.
translation_zh: 如盥洗室地板般光亮，\r站內牆面潔淨刺目。

original_en: Painted with a dull\rbattleship grey color, the\rdoor is firmly closed.
translation_zh: 漆著暗沉戰艦灰，\r門緊閉不開。

original_en: A holographic display crystal\rglistens on the glass-top\rtable.
translation_zh: 全像顯示水晶在\r玻璃面桌上熠熠生輝。

original_en: A series of geometric shapes\rhave been worked into the\rfloor's elaborate tile work.
translation_zh: 地板精緻磁磚拼工中\r嵌入一系列幾何圖形。

original_en: The floor receptacle appears\rto be empty.
translation_zh: 地面凹槽似乎是空的。

original_en: Blackened by an intense burst\rof heat, this section of\rfloor is in desperate need of\rrepair.
translation_zh: 遭高溫劇烈灼黑，\r此處地板亟需修繕。

original_en: A number of wiring junctions\rare visible through a viewing\rplate set into the floor.
translation_zh: 透過地面觀察板可見\r數處電線接點。

original_en: A small handful of rocks have\rbeen scattered on the floor\rof the atrium.
translation_zh: 中庭地面散落\r著一小撮石塊。

original_en: Doubtlessly created\rartificially by the station's\rdecorator, this meteorite\rcrater is only a scant meter\rdeep.
translation_zh: 無疑是站內裝潢師\r人為造景，這隕石坑\r深僅一公尺出頭。

original_en: A simple checkerboard pattern\radorns this area of the\rstation flooring.
translation_zh: 簡單棋盤格紋\r裝飾此區地板。

original_en: The monitor appears to be\rdisplaying a newscast.
translation_zh: 螢幕似乎正在\r播放新聞。

original_en: Glowing an angry red, the\rmonitor flickers rapidly on\rand off.
translation_zh: 螢幕暴怒紅光\r急促閃爍。

original_en: After looking at a complex\rseries of patterns on the\rmonitor's screens, %\rrealizes that the diagram is\ran alien analogue of a\rstation directory.
translation_zh: 細看螢幕上一連串複\r雜圖樣後，% 領\r悟此圖即為站內導覽\r的外星對應版。

original_en: Its function uncertain, the\rdevice appears to be out of\rorder.
translation_zh: 功能不明，此裝置\r似乎故障了。

original_en: Quivering bursts of red pulse\rfrom the tele- trans homing\rbeacon.
translation_zh: 跳躍傳送歸航信標\r顫動著噴出紅光。

original_en: Overstuffed and smelling of\rfresh vinyl, the viewing\rchair appears to have been\rrecently installed.
translation_zh: 填料飽滿、散發新乙\r烯味，觀景椅似乎\r剛安裝不久。

original_en: A tactical display of the\rorbital traffic over the\rplanet glows on this panel.
translation_zh: 面板上閃耀著\r行星上空軌道流量\r的戰術顯示。

original_en: Formed into the wall itself,\rthe niche appears to have a\rspecial purpose.
translation_zh: 嵌入牆內的壁龕\r似乎別有用途。

original_en: It is a severed android head.
translation_zh: 是顆斷裂的機器人頭。

original_en: Various technical readouts\rswirl around a computer-drawn\rimage of a planetary core.
translation_zh: 各式技術讀數圍繞著\r電腦繪製的行星核心圖。

original_en: It's a table.
translation_zh: 是張桌子。

original_en: Cycling madly through the\rspectrum of colors, the\rstation alert beacon appears\rto have been activated.
translation_zh: 狂亂掃過色譜的站內\r警示燈號，似乎已\r被啟動。

original_en: The station alert beacon has\rbeen deactivated.
translation_zh: 站內警示燈號已\r解除。

original_en: Although it looks repairable,\rthe station generator has\rbeen very severely damaged.
translation_zh: 雖看似可修復，\r站內發電機已嚴重\r受損。

original_en: The control panel looks as if\rit was very hastily shut off.
translation_zh: 控制面板看似\r倉促關閉。

original_en: Aligned in massive banks, the\rdisplays on this panel appear\rto be monitoring the status\rof several of the station's\rlife support features.
translation_zh: 龐大陣列排列著，\r此面板顯示似在監\r控站內多項維生系\r統的狀態。

original_en: A deep hole has been blasted\rin this panel.
translation_zh: 此面板被炸出\r一個深洞。

original_en: Fused into a lump of slag,\rthis panel would appear to be\ruseless.
translation_zh: 熔成一團熔渣，\r此面板似乎無用。

original_en: Displayed in vivid colors,\rthe map would appear to be a\rtactical view of the Centauri\rStar System.
translation_zh: 以鮮明色彩呈現，\r此圖似為半人馬星\r系的戰術視圖。

original_en: It's the floor.
translation_zh: 是地板。

original_en: Hastily tossed to one side,\rthis piece of laboratory\requipment appears to have\rbeen ruined.
translation_zh: 倉促拋向一旁，\r這件實驗器材似已\r毀損。
